data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish name 'Enrique', meaning 'rich in grace'. In Christian tradition, it is believed that the name represents the blessing and favor of God. The name Enrique carries the meaning “Rich in grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Enrique usually hope their child will grow to embody rich in grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes God's grace and favor.
data.etymology: Enrique belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rich in grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Enrique total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
